description:
Get earned sBTC rewards for a specific Dual Stacking cycle.

Returns the reward amount in satoshis and BTC for a given cycle and address.
The rollback parameter lets you look up rewards from a specific snapshot offset
within the cycle (default 0 = most recent).

Note: Dual Stacking is only available on mainnet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

address.description: Address to query rewards for. Uses configured wallet if not provided.

cycle.description: Cycle number to query rewards for

rollback.description: Snapshot rollback offset within the cycle (default 0)

name: dual_stacking_get_rewards
